message.content:
Below is a list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada in 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on the nearest weekday when they fall on a weekend).  
These are the federal holidays that create a 3‑day weekend for most Canadians.  (Some provinces have additional holidays that may also create long weekends, but those are not listed here.)

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|---------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day | **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | Jan 1 is Sunday; observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Feb 20 is the holiday; observed on the same day. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday is Friday; Easter Monday is not a holiday in Canada. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 – May 22** | May 22 is the holiday (Monday). |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Jul 1 is Saturday; observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Sep 4 is the holiday (Monday). |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Oct 9 is the holiday (Monday). |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Nov 11 is Saturday; observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Dec 25 is Monday; creates a 3‑day weekend. |

### Quick Reference (Date Ranges)

- **Jan 1–2** – New Year’s  
- **Feb 18–20** – Family Day  
- **Apr 7–9** – Good Friday  
- **May 20–22** – Victoria Day  
- **Jul 1–3** – Canada Day  
- **Sep 2–4** – Labour Day  
- **Oct 7–9** – Thanksgiving  
- **Nov 11–13** – Remembrance Day  
- **Dec 23–25** – Christmas  

These are the primary long weekends you’ll see across Canada in 2023. If you’re targeting a specific province, you may want to add any provincial holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island).
